posts.body: Does anyone remember how we handled the expansion draft last year? Did we follow it verbatim from the rules, or tweak it to account for only having one expansion team?

We held 8 players for ourselves and each team could only lose 3 players.  The question I have is will we drop to 25 players on the roster again now that we are back to 10 teams?  Do we have confirmation that everyone is coming back?

I remember protecting 8 on our roster.
I couldn’t remember how many the expansion team could take. I think it says 4, so I assumed that. However, maybe it was just 3 from each team because it was only one expansion team. I’m guessing the rules were written assuming we’d be adding at least 2 teams.
Protecting 8 max 3 sounds about right. Let's roll with that. We have confirmation everyone is in except Owner 0009, who I haven't heard from. I'm assuming he's in since he hasn't said he's out.

On the question of roster size, I think we put that up for a vote during the draft. I expect it would be something we'd want to implement for next year, if we do it, to give everyone time to adjust. But if it's unanimous we could do it this year.
Are we just declaring our protected players at the draft, or is there somewhere we should be posting them beforehand?

I'd like to do it beforehand to give Owner 0010 at least a little prep time but currently working on more basic things like confirming everyone is playing this year.

Let's assume Owner 0009 is in. Shall we go for a deadline of Wed night at 11:59pm to declare?

I think declaring with a bit of advanced notice is key for the expansion team. And, to be honest, helpful for the rest of us, because we’ll know who is still on our rosters heading into the auction.
I might even suggest Tuesday would be better. Tha would give Owner 0010 time to select and allow teams a chance to know more about who we still have heading into Friday. However, I’m up for whatever works for the majority of teams.

You get to protect 8 players. It can be anyone on your roster, even if they’re a restricted free agent (in which case you’re just protecting matching rights and/or a franchise option). Deadline is Wednesday 11:59pm.

Per the rules, the expansion team gets a draft slot randomly chosen between 3-6 and a supplemental pick at the end of each round. I have done the random draw and it was #4. I have set up the draft accordingly, if you want to see all the picks take a look here: https://www44.myfantasyleague.com/2024/options?L=48571&O=17

1. Divisions, schedule, and playoffs now that we have 10 teams. I propose we go to the following. This nice thing about this is the site can generate this schedule so I don't have to do it manually:
- 2 divisions with 5 teams each
- 14 Week regular season: Play all 4 teams in your division twice and 5 teams outside your division once or twice
- Playoffs in week 15 and 16
- 4 teams make playoffs: two division winners + two wild cards (based on all-play)

2a. Do we want to reduce max roster size back to 25 now that we have 10 teams?
2b. If yes to 2a, do we want to adjust the salary cap back to 250 as well?

If anyone has comments or other things you think we should vote on, post them in here.

I would add 2c.  Go back to 8 starters

1 QB
1-2 RB
2-4 WR
1 TE
1 KR
I would also add: 2d - Back to a 4 round draft
Sorry if I'm overstepping being the new team. However, I did base my expansion draft on Thirty total players and a 300 Salary cap. So I would vote against the 25 and 250 in 2a. and 2b.

Sorry guys, I have already forgotten how we decided to do the playoffs.  Can someone remind me?
We decided to do a 14 week regular season and 3 week playoff (byes for division winners, 6 teams total).

My record and overall points seem to tell me I should be a seller at the deadline, so let’s make a deal.
I’m looking for picks or young players with good contracts.
Most everyone is on the block, but I’m mostly interested in trading those with 1 or 2 yrs left on their deals.
So, who wants to dominate the playoffs with my help????

I have a few ideas that I’ll post here.
Please post any ideas you have for the upcoming season(s).

FG Distance Tier Points

While I continue to suggest we eliminate kickers, the majority of our league seems to enjoy the position.
It is in this spirit of surrender, and with kickers making longer and longer FGs, that I propose we extend the tiered scoring to include longer-distance FGs.

Currently we score FGs the following way:
1-39yds = 3pts
40-49yds = 4pts
50-99yds = 5pts

Why not add 60yd, and if robotic legs allow, even higher??
60-69yds = 6pts
70-79yds = 7pts
80-89yds = 8pts
90-99yds = 9pts

Tight End Premium

Unless you have one of the top TEs on your roster, this position rarely scores many points.

Through week 13 …
32 RBs are 100+ scorers (5 are 200+)
36 WRs are 100+ scorers
14 Ks are 100+ scorers
8 TEs are 100+ scorers

In an attempt to keep the Tight End position relevant, I propose that we adjust our scoring to tight end premium.

In the past, we have played in leagues that valued WR receptions more than RB receptions in an attempt to level the importance of each position. And, our fairly recent super flex addition was intended to maintain the importance of QB.

Therefore, I propose the following 2 options:

Increase TE reception values to 1pt (A half point higher than all other positions).

Or

Increase TE reception values to 1.5pts (A full point higher than all other positions).

I noticed something awkward when setting up our new playoff format. Draft order next year for playoff teams is reverse order of finish. However, with a 3 week playoff we do not have a way to rank the 5th and 6th place teams (the losers in the first round). It doesn't make sense to have them play each other because they would both be incentivized to lose since there is no prize money for 5th place.

For this year, I will be flipping a coin to determine who picks first between these two teams, but we should vote on something for next year.

I would propose we set up a 5th/6th place game and the winner gets the higher pick. Gives those two playoff teams something to play for in the final week.

Fantasy year follows NFL new year

Making decisions for the following fantasy season would be better with more knowledge of what the NFL/Teams plan to do heading into that season.

Therefore, I suggest that our new year coincides with the the NFL. That is, the NFL new year will be the same day as our new contract year

It sounds like Owner 0008 has found two new recruits for us next year - his son and his wife's brother. I have put up a poll for everyone to weigh in on their support to expand to 12 teams next year. My personal vote is yes - this league was originally designed for 12 teams. More teams means bigger payouts and also adds to the challenge. But I want to make sure everyone else feels the same way, so please vote if you care.
